office_does: The county treasurer runs the county treasury and its finances.
race_blurb: Uncontested open seat: longtime Treasurer Renee Goodin is retiring, and Sheila Didion (Prefers Independent Party), a senior accountant in the office, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Senior accountant in the treasurer's office, previously in the auditor's and sheriff's offices; the only candidate.
highlights: Former auditor's office payroll/benefits technician and sheriff's dispatcher [S1]
Background in banking, payroll and accounts payable [S1]
